abort.already_setup: Only one hub allowed, configure existing using a CSV list of IP addresses

data.auto_charge_forecast_field: Estimate to use (hourly forecast sensors only)
data.auto_charge_consumption: Consumption sensor (leave empty to use Current Load)
data.auto_charge_margin_soc: Safety margin added to the target
data.auto_charge_window_start: Cheap charge window start (if no schedule)
data.auto_charge_window_end: Cheap charge window end (if no schedule)
data.auto_charge_run_time: Calculate and set the target at (if no schedule)

data_description.auto_charge_forecast_today: A sensor whose value is today's forecast solar generation (kWh or Wh), or one with Solcast-style hourly detail. Plain totals are spread over the day in the shape of your own PV output.
data_description.auto_charge_forecast_tomorrow: The same for tomorrow. Both are needed because the target is written after midnight, when the day it plans for has become today.
data_description.auto_charge_forecast_field: For sensors with Solcast-style hourly detail: pessimistic (P10) rarely leaves you short; typical (P50) charges less on average. Ignored for plain totals.
data_description.auto_charge_consumption: An energy (kWh) or power (kW/W) sensor. Its last 7 days of hourly statistics give your usual usage for each hour of the day.
data_description.auto_charge_capacity_kwh: For example 14.4 for a Dura16 LV, or 4.6 per Dura5. Set this to turn on the Auto Grid Charge planner.
data_description.auto_charge_margin_soc: Extra SoC on top of what the forecast says you need.
data_description.auto_charge_window_start: When the cheap window usually starts. Used to work out where the day being planned ends.
data_description.auto_charge_window_end: When the cheap window usually ends. The plan starts here, when the battery is expected to be at the target. If your window moves with the seasons, an approximate time is fine.
data_description.auto_charge_run_time: Pick a time before your earliest charge window start (e.g. 00:45 if the window moves between 01:00 and 02:00). The target is written then, while the Auto Grid Charge switch is on.
data_description.auto_charge_window_schedule: A schedule helper that is on during your cheap window (e.g. schedule.night_tariff). When set, the target is calculated and written as the schedule turns on, and the window times and run time below are only used as a fallback.
